title: Powered Tools
subtitle: Built on a Tool Stand
text:
Place a Tool Stand and fit the parts in order, using the screwdriver after each one:

1 Frame  2 Core  3 Control board  4 Battery module  5 Upgrades (optional, up to 2)

The core decides the tool: a Drill Motor makes an Electric Drill (pickaxe and shovel blocks), a Chainsaw Bar a Chainsaw (axe blocks). Any time after the core, a Diamond Drill Bit or Diamond-Tipped Chain can be fitted and screwed on. Take the finished tool off with an empty hand.
caption: Drill and chainsaw

steps.title: Parts in order
steps.text: Right click with the part, then the screwdriver.
Put a tool back on an empty stand to change it: sneak with the screwdriver to take the last part off. Parts drop back, and the battery module keeps its charge.
